Everything is green. Final state of the work:

**Implementation** (`/workspace/project`):
- **`src/star4_switch.c`** — complete rewrite of the collector: strict two-stage ingress validation (wire validity: lengths, IPv4 header checksum, ports, BTH/APSN/AETH rules, exact 4D payloads, ICRC masking rule; then endpoint validity: MAC/IP/QPN, required source, p<K) with single-count classification; per-source contiguous receive prefixes R; mode-2 downstream-gated vs mode-3 immediate upstream ACK eligibility E; cumulative downstream ACKs with prefix effectiveness at packet arrival; bounded logical-p retention window with first-occurrence (p,source) admission, duplicate/stale repeat-ACK requests, blocked drops; retirement b requiring completeness + all required outputs acknowledged + U>p; the three-phase emission priority (pending upstream ACKs ascending rank → retry-only sent-unacked retransmissions ascending q → new results ascending destination rank/q) with budget failures ending the opportunity, counting failed sends and retiring whatever succeeded; canonical egress construction; FNV1a64 buffer digest and the exact 32-word state vector.
- **`src/replay_api.c`** — thin ABI glue; **`src/roce_packet.c`** codec builders retained and reused; **`solver.py`/`wire.py`/`request.py`** kept as the entry point, format expansion and full batch validation (illegal batches → exactly `{"error":"invalid"}`, exit 0, before any compilation).

**Validation performed**:
- `python3 public_check.py project/solver.py` → **2/2 PASS**
- ~3,500 randomized batches fuzzed against an independent Python reference model (all six collectives, both modes, wrapped near-2^24 PSNs, reordered/duplicate/blocked/stale data, crafted/corrupt wire frames, budget stalls, retries, snaps, trains) — full certificates (state, buffer digest, wire tape hash, snapshots, traces) agree byte-for-byte
- 62 hand-derived scenario checks (mode-2 reliability gating, gather/scatter q-mapping and payload bytes, barrier, broadcast nonroot-invalid, repeat-ACK persistence, budget truncation/resume, retry ordering) and 58 invalid/valid request checks
- heavy batches near the 2^20-work / 256 MiB contract bounds complete in seconds; source compiles clean under `-Wpedantic -Wconversion`
